quick.summary: Why nods prove nothing, and three quick checks that show who understood.
quick.takeaway: Don’t ask if it made sense. Ask what happens next.

beats.line: I explained the change twice. Why did everyone build the old thing?
Did you ask if it made sense?
Nodding is polite. It is not proof.
So what, I quiz my team now?
No quiz. You ask about their work, not their memory.
One. Ask them to say the next step back to you.
Two. Ask what might get in the way.
Three. Sum it up in one line, and ask them to correct it.

board.text: 3  Recap in one line, ask for fixes

beats.line: So, before we hang up, what will you do first?
That one question catches the mix up before work starts.

quiz.question: Which question best shows that someone understood your request?
quiz.explanation: It asks them to say the next step in their own words, so a mix up shows straight away.

quiz.question: If everyone nods, you can assume they understood.
quiz.explanation: Nodding is often just politeness. Hearing their next step shows what they actually took away.
